mechanism_narrative: High consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is above its 50th percentile.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 4.0% within three months signals labor market deterioration, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.0%).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals monetary tightening suppressing economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and INDPRO falls.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising), a decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) signals weakening demand, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising, and RSAFS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017 base) indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in federal funds rate above 4.5% within three months signals active monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%).

mechanism_narrative: High employment growth (PAYEMS) reflects a tight labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth is above its 50th percentile.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in consumer spending (RSAFS) and fall in housing starts (HOUST) signals a shift in consumer preferences, indicating economic fragility and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS rises and HOUST falls.
